title: Dropbox app key, webhook signature and placeholder client_secret values
summary: An app key (client_id) with no client_secret, an X-Dropbox-Signature header holding an HMAC output, and a client_secret field holding a placeholder, an environment reference, a template reference or a masked display.
rationale: The app key is the public identifier registered beside the secret. The X-Dropbox-Signature value is an HMAC-SHA256 of the request body computed with the app secret as key, so it is a derived output and does not contain the secret. A placeholder or reference stands in for a value kept elsewhere, and a masked display has no recoverable value.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: the values here are identifiers, placeholders, references, masked text or non-secret outputs, not credential values. That a placeholder or reference is not a value is a project decision, not a Dropbox statement.

sources.supports: Calls to /oauth2/token need to be authenticated using the apps's key and secret.
